issues.description: Problem statement Part 1 instructs students to implement a POST handler method named `createPerson` in `PersonResource`, but the reference solution implements the POST endpoint handler as `addPerson`. While the endpoint path is still `POST /persons`, the differing method name makes it harder to map the instructions to the provided code structure and can lead students to implement a differently named method than intended.
issues.suggestedFix: Align naming across artifacts: either update the problem statement to call the POST handler `addPerson`, or rename the intended/template/solution method to `createPerson` while keeping `@PostMapping("persons")` unchanged.
